mapper.sql: select b.id, b.booking_no, b.merchant_id, m.distributor_id, m.name as merchant_name, b.store_id, b.user_id, u.user_name, b.booking_service_id, b.product_id, b.product_name, b.product_image, b.product_price, b.booking_time, b.contact_name, b.contact_phone, b.people_count, b.status, b.confirm_time, b.complete_time, b.cancel_time, b.expire_time, b.create_time, b.update_time, b.remark, b.del_flag from mall_booking b left join merchant m on b.merchant_id = m.id left join user_info u on b.user_id = u.id
mapper.insert:
insert into mall_booking
booking_no, merchant_id, store_id, user_id, booking_service_id, product_id, product_name, product_image, product_price, booking_time, contact_name, contact_phone, people_count, status, confirm_time, complete_time, cancel_time, expire_time, create_time, update_time, remark, del_flag,
#{bookingNo}, #{merchantId}, #{storeId}, #{userId}, #{bookingServiceId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productImage}, #{productPrice}, #{bookingTime}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{peopleCount}, #{status}, #{confirmTime}, #{completeTime}, #{cancelTime}, #{expireTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}, #{delFlag},
mapper.update: update mall_booking set status = #{status}, update_time = #{statusTime}, confirm_time = case when #{status} = 'CONFIRMED' then #{statusTime} else confirm_time end, complete_time = case when #{status} = 'COMPLETED' then #{statusTime} else complete_time end, cancel_time = case when #{status} = 'CANCELLED' then #{statusTime} else cancel_time end, expire_time = case when #{status} = 'EXPIRED' then #{statusTime} else expire_time end where booking_no = #{bookingNo} and del_flag = '0'

update mall_booking set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_time = #{expireTime}, update_time = #{expireTime}, remark = case when remark is null or remark = '' then '超过预点单时间1小时未到店，系统自动取消' when remark like '%系统自动取消%' then remark else concat(remark, '；超过预点单时间1小时未到店，系统自动取消') end where user_id = #{userId} and status in ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') and date_add(booking_time, interval 1 hour) < #{expireTime} and del_flag = '0'

update mall_booking set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_time = #{expireTime}, update_time = #{expireTime}, remark = case when remark is null or remark = '' then '超过预点单时间1小时未到店，系统自动取消' when remark like '%系统自动取消%' then remark else concat(remark, '；超过预点单时间1小时未到店，系统自动取消') end where status in ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') and date_add(booking_time, interval 1 hour) < #{expireTime} and del_flag = '0'
